notes: Key contact: Priya Malhotra (Head of Search Product) — wants predictable ops + deterministic reranking scores.
Use-case: product search + recommendations -> reranker sits downstream of candidate retriever (BM25 + ANN).
POC scope: evaluate Hosted rerank endpoint for relevance tuning; offline scoring for 100k candidate-query pairs; produce NDCG@10, MRR, pairwise win-rate.
Metrics they care about: NDCG@10 uplift vs current baseline (target +12-18%), latency SLAs for online rerank: median <150ms for 10-item candidate list, p95 <300ms.
Throughput: expected steady-state 20 qps for UI; bulk nightly offline scoring up to 500k queries (batch).
Candidate pool: typical 50-200 per query for on-site, occasionally up to 1k for analytics use-cases.
Desired rerank endpoint features: return normalized scores + logits, optional feature provenance for debugging, accept precomputed embeddings and/or raw doc ids.
Offline scoring requirements: support CSV/NDJSON uploads, API or S3 pull for candidate sets, ability to stream back scored results (no strict streaming requirement).
Model prefs: prefer open-weight llama-variants and quantized variants for cost, but want Redwood to recommend quantization profile and fallback smaller model for cold starts.
Cost sensitivity: mid-market — willing to commit to Dedicated if unit economics are predictable; asking for modeled 12-mo commit scenarios (25k, 50k, 100k tokens/day).
Security ask: SOC2 report + ability to push audit logs to their SIEM; SSO via SAML and option for KMS-managed keys in Dedicated/VPC.
Quote from Priya: 'We need scores we can action — not just blobs. Show us stable deltas across eval sets.'
Integration notes: backend in GCP (us-central), front-end expects <200ms RTT for rerank call; prefer same-region routing for Hosted -> mitigates latency.
POC blockers: outstanding answers on retention windows (they require 90-day audit logs), encryption at rest keys model for Dedicated, and estimated overage rates for bursts.
Comp comparisons: they ran a short test vs Elastic rerank plugin and saw better qualitative results from Redwood-hosted models on long-tail queries.
Action items assigned: Jordan to deliver final POC report + cost model (due 2024-11-07); Aisha to prep Dedicated sizing options; Priya to align procurement calendar for Jan decision.

Follow-up plan: run 3 additional eval sets focusing on personalization signals; test rerank-cost tradeoffs with 8-bit quantized model variant.
Sales signal: high — product team enthusiastic; procurement is primary gating factor (Q1 budget).
